item.title: ScrollEd wants to turn textbooks into TikTok
item.description: ScrollEd turns textbooks into a scrollable, Instagram-like feed with video, audio, and quizzes. The Palo Alto startup, founded by student co-founders (and spouses) Utsav Gupta and Rebecca Neff, pitches at TechCrunch Disrupt.

item.title: I tested the Samsung R95H RGB TV — and while OLED is still the top dog, this TV shows that RGB mini-LED has massive potential
item.description: The Samsung R95H is a successful first foray into RGB TVs for the brand, and while the tech still can't quite topple OLED, it's a sign of what RGB mini-LED tech is capable of.

item.title: Speechify is pricey, but it’s also completely transformed how I digest information
item.description: Homescreen Heroes: Speechify can read out documents, images, websites, and more

item.title: The benefits of using an E Ink tablet over an iPad
item.description: E Ink excels for tasks like reading and note-taking.

item.title: Test de la Philips Baristina Latte : la reine du cappuccino mignonne, mi-automatique
item.description: Une machine à café clé en main, qui broie le grain, réalise des expressos et de belles mousses de lait quasiment seule : telle est la promesse de la Baristina Latte de Philips.

item.title: Grâce à Amazon, cette batterie externe d’Ugreen, compatible avec la charge sans fil, frôle les 50 euros
item.description: Parmi les nombreux points forts de cette Ugreen MagFlow Air, il y a la recharge sans fil et la réduction de 25 % proposée par Amazon.

item.title: How to customize the side button on your Samsung Galaxy phone
item.description: The side button on Samsung's Galaxy phones has performed different functions over the years, but you can really make it do whatever you want.

item.title: Quels sont les meilleurs thermostats connectés en 2026 ?
item.description: Ces dernières années, les prix du gaz et de l'électricité ont explosé. Il est ainsi devenu urgent de réduire notre impact écologique et nos factures. Les thermostats intelligents sont des alliés de choix pour faire des économies d'énergie. Découvrez notre sélection des meilleurs thermostats connectés.

item.description: The startup is looking to expand beyond electric air taxi rides in major cities.

item.title: New California law will penalize influencers who don’t disclose political ads
item.description: The new legislation adds teeth to disclosure requirements for online influencers who are paid to post about politics.

item.title: What's the 30-degree rule for TVs?
item.description: The Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers has a simple method for calculating the ideal viewing distance based on your TV size.
